name: sigil-pf2e
description: Offline Pathfinder 2e spell-circle editor, Node.js build tools

scripts.dev: npm run compile && npm run build:docs && node src/tools/dev-server.js
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:docs && node src/tools/build-standalone.js
scripts.build:public: npm run compile && npm run build:docs && node src/tools/build-standalone.js --public
scripts.test:core: npm run compile && node src/tests/calculation-test.js && node src/tests/test.js && node src/tools/test-calculation-audit.js
scripts.test: npm run test:core && node src/tests/catalog-test.js && node src/tests/card-test.js
scripts.test:public: npm run test:core && node src/tests/catalog-test.js --public && node src/tests/card-test.js --public
scripts.check:source: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.check:public: npm run check:source && npm run test:public
